[Skeptical? Good. So are we.]

##### Skeptical? Good. So are we.

If you've been let down by bold claims from supplement companies before, we understand. We have too.
That's why we do things differently.

We didn't just say our calcium supplement increases bone density. We backed it. With not one, not
two, **but three human clinical studies.** These independent studies were published in peer-reviewed
scientific journals. And the results have been confirmed by **thousands of DEXA scans in medical
clinics across all 50 states.**

** So if you're skeptical, we welcome it. ** Read the studies. Check the ingredients. Head to
YouTube and search “AlgaeCal reviews.” Because when something actually works, it doesn't mind being
held to a higher standard.

The numbers don't lie.

And the results speak for themselves.

[Clinically Supported]

##### Clinically Supported

AlgaeCal has been studied in ** three human clinical trials** conducted by researchers from leading
institutions including ** Harvard Medical School, Georgetown University, and the University of
Texas.** The conclusion was the same across all three:

**AlgaeCal is the only calcium supplement ever shown to increase bone density^{‡}.**

[Most Natural Calcium Supplements are Made From Rocks]

Plant-Based Calcium

##### Most Natural Calcium Supplements are Made From Rocks

** AlgaeCal is different. It's made from organic marine algae ** — mesophyllum superpositum - a
plant-based source that naturally contains ** all the bone-supporting minerals your body ** needs to
stop bone loss and increase bone density.

# Innovative marine biotechnologies

Marinova is an Australian biotechnology company dedicated to the development and production of high
purity seaweed extracts for the betterment of human health. We specialise in the research,
development and manufacture of [fucoidan ][41]compounds – highly bioactive polysaccharides derived
from select species of brown seaweed.­

As the global leader in fucoidan science, Marinova is the supplier of choice to world-renowned
research institutions. Our reputation is built on the unrivalled quality and efficacy of our
bioactive fucoidan extracts and two decades of rigorous scientific investigation. 

Marinova’s global research and development program welcomes [collaborators][42] that share our
mindset for scientific innovation. Our highly characterised fucoidan fractions are well-suited to
medical device applications and pharmaceutical research.

Marinova is also home to the unique range of [Maritech^{®} organic fucoidan ][43]extracts - high
purity fucoidans developed specifically for nutritional, cosmetic and animal health applications.

**Marinova: Pure Source, Pure Science.**

# Innovative marine biotechnologies

Marinova is an Australian biotechnology company dedicated to the development and production of high
purity seaweed extracts for the betterment of human health. We specialise in the research,
development and manufacture of [fucoidan ][41]compounds – highly bioactive polysaccharides derived
from select species of brown seaweed.­

As the global leader in fucoidan science, Marinova is the supplier of choice to world-renowned
research institutions. Our reputation is built on the unrivalled quality and efficacy of our
bioactive fucoidan extracts and two decades of rigorous scientific investigation. 

Marinova’s global research and development program welcomes [collaborators][42] that share our
mindset for scientific innovation. Our highly characterised fucoidan fractions are well-suited to
medical device applications and pharmaceutical research.

Marinova is also home to the unique range of [Maritech^{®} organic fucoidan ][43]extracts - high
purity fucoidans developed specifically for nutritional, cosmetic and animal health applications.

**Marinova: Pure Source, Pure Science.**

## Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about Veterinary APIs, Human APIs, bulk supply, exports, and contract
manufacturing.

Who is the leading Veterinary API manufacturer in India?

Aarambh Life Science is a GMP-certified Veterinary API manufacturer in India, supplying high-quality
active pharmaceutical ingredients for animal healthcare applications worldwide.

Do you manufacture both Veterinary APIs and Human APIs?

Yes, Aarambh Life Science manufactures and supplies a wide range of Veterinary APIs and Human APIs
for pharmaceutical companies globally.

How do I choose a reliable API manufacturer in India?

When selecting an API manufacturer, consider GMP compliance, product quality, manufacturing
capabilities, regulatory standards, documentation support, and supply reliability. Aarambh Life
Science follows stringent quality practices and provides reliable API supply solutions for
pharmaceutical companies.

Is Aarambh Life Science a GMP-certified API manufacturer?

Yes, we follow GMP-compliant manufacturing processes and stringent quality standards to ensure
product safety and consistency.

Do you export APIs internationally?

Yes, we export Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to pharmaceutical companies, distributors, and
healthcare organizations across international markets.

Why source Veterinary and Human APIs from India?

India is a global hub for pharmaceutical manufacturing, offering high-quality APIs, GMP-compliant
production facilities, skilled expertise, and cost-effective supply solutions. Aarambh Life Science
supplies Veterinary APIs and Human APIs to domestic and international markets.

What quality documents are available with your APIs?

We provide relevant documentation including COA, specifications, and other quality-related documents
based on customer requirements.

How can I request a quotation for APIs?

You can contact our team through the inquiry form or Contact Us page to receive a customized
quotation for your API requirements.

**Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd.** is emerging as a leader in pharmaceutical manufacturing,
exporting, and supplying from India.

“Innovate and automate, with human touch in manufacturing process to provide affordable
pharmaceutical products to make a healthier world.”  

Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. follows high global standards in formulation manufacturing with
latest machinery. We are specialized in the manufacturing and exporting of [finished
formulations][64] that cater to the most demanding global needs. We are on the verge of becoming one
of the largest pharmaceutical companies in India when it comes to [contract manufacturing][65] of
[Tablets][66], [Capsules][67], [Injections][68],[Creams/Ointments][69], [Drops][70], [Infusion][71],

The manufacturing and R&D facility of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd. is located in Surat, Gujarat,
India. It contains multiple formulation facilities in close proximity that are further sub-divided
to specific zones dedicated to particular tasks. With well-established supply chain and vendor
development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

Our world-class manufacturing plant is equipped with modern high-speed machines and integrated
packaging lines. Our heavily automated systems include non-fill devices, collators, multi-station
tablet presses, brevetti visual inspection machines, FFS machines and high-speed vial/ampoule
filler/sealer. Our Highly professional research team works hand-in-hand with the machines to
manufacture high-quality cost-efficient products.

To support our end-to-end pharmaceutical capabilities, **[Actiza Industry][77]** operates as a
wholly owned subsidiary of Actiza Pharmaceutical Pvt. Ltd., specializing in the manufacturing of
**Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs)** and **pharmaceutical intermediates**. This backward
integration enhances our ability to maintain strict quality control, optimize supply chains, and
ensure regulatory compliance across all markets. As a reliable **API manufacturer**, Actiza Industry
plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

From dossier preparation to marketing authorization filing, our Pharmaceutical [Regulatory
Services][78] cover CTD, eCTD, and ACTD formats supporting product registration across 40+ countries
in both regulated and semi-regulated markets.

development systems, we have built an in-house pharmaceutical ecosystem.

plays a critical role in delivering high-quality raw materials that power our finished formulations,
reinforcing our commitment to excellence from molecule to medicine.

# Your Global CDMO

As a global CDMO headquartered in Munich, Germany, we are committed to fulfilling the pharmaceutical
needs of clients throughout Europe, Japan and North America. Our approach is rooted in a
customer-centric philosophy that guarantees exceptional quality and service in every aspect.

## [Our Offering][112]

We are a reliable CDMO partner, providing comprehensive Development and Manufacturing services for
drug products, from small molecules to large molecules. We offer end-to-end services for your small
molecule finished dosage forms (FDFs), including sterile and non-sterile liquids, solids, and
semi-solids products, and we are also specialised in biologicals, orphan drugs, clinical trials,
fill-and-finish, and lyophilisation.

### Athens, Greece

With more than 3,000 sqm of R&D facilities, our team in Athens specialises in the development of
Value Added Medicines and has been recently upgraded with HPAPI capabilities.

⟶][121]
[[flag][flag]

### Halden, Norway

Halden is one of the largest and most advanced sterile production facilities in Northern Europe. It
specialises in the production and distribution of IV bags and plastic ampoules using Blow-Fill Seal
(BFS) technology.

⟶][122]
[[flag][flag]

### Jura, Switzerland

We provide a complete range of services tailored to both Clinical Manufacturing and Commercial
Manufacturing needs, and we specialise in small-batch production with a customised approach.  

⟶][123]
[[flag][flag]

### Kawagoe, Japan

Our state-of-the-art manufacturing site specialises in ampoules, tablets and visual inspection
services. We offer excellent customer service in English and Japanese. It has one of the largest
cold storage warehouses in Japan.

⟶][124]
[[flag][flag]

### Livron, France

With over 100 years of experience, Adragos Livron focuses on sterile liquids and suppositories
manufacturing. We handle more than 100 molecules and provide stability studies, narcotics handling
and analytical testing services.

⟶][125]
[[flag][flag]

### Leipzig, Germany

Our manufacturing facility in Leipzig specialises in semi-solid and non-sterile liquid
pharmaceuticals. With over 100 years of experience, we have a track record of providing first-class
service and customer-focused manufacturing.

⟶][126]
[[flag][flag]

### Maisons-Alfort, France

At our facility in France, we manufacture sterile prefilled syringes and liquid or lyophilised
vials.
With high-speed aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and integrated packaging, the site uses
GMP-compliant CIP/SIP and RABS technologies to ensure quality and reliable global supply.

### Our Mission

We strive for a happier, healthier tomorrow. We shall be working on total customer satisfaction and
achieve leadership in pharmaceutical marketplace, products and services across the globe, through
excellence in technology, based on research and development , compliance with regulatory
requirements and expectation in an effective and efficient manner. Our human resources will continue

Our vision is to be leading pharmaceutical company in India and become a significant global player.

the world including the developing countries. We apply to enrich our people – our driving force, to
become highly competent professional and technology based.

Why Choose Us

Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. is a young & emerging global pharmaceutical manufacturing &
marketing company. We manufacture & market a broad range of Pharmaceutical finished formulations.

In the year 2000, Mr. Jitendra Prasad, a young Engineering graduate having pharmaceutical project
background, had established Akriti Export Agencies. In very short span of time he had given a
profitable shape of business to Akriti Export Agencies because of his hard work and very positive
mental attitude. Our activities range from manufacturing & marketing of finished pharmaceutical
formulations of Niche therapeutic segments. Akriti Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. has its headquarter in
Thane suburb of Mumbai, the financial capital of India .

Akriti Pharmaceuticals has operation in ** CIS Countries** and now expanding its wings to
**European, South East Asian, Latin American, Middle East & African countries**.

Our manufacturing unit has been approved with various International certifications and follows the
laid down norms of FDA India, CGMP under Schedule 'M' as well as it is **WHO-GMP **certified.

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

### **AMERICAN ENERGY SECURITY FRAMEWORK**

Recent geopolitical disruptions and their impact on global energy markets have been a stark reminder
that energy security remains inseparable from economic security and geopolitical stability. The
United States is better positioned than most nations to navigate market volatility, thanks to
decades of investment and innovation that made America the world's leading producer of oil and
natural gas and a reliable supplier to global markets. But future disruptions will require a
stronger, more flexible energy system—one built on secure supply, modern infrastructure and
resilience.

The following recommendations provide a framework for getting there.

SECURE AMERICAN ENERGY SUPPLY
* Develop a Robust Federal Offshore Leasing Program
* Ensure Stable, Consistent Fuel Supply Through a Functional Renewable Fuel Standard
* Optimize the Strategic Petroleum Reserve

BUILD INFRASTRUCTURE AND MOVE ENERGY
* Pass Comprehensive Permitting Reform
* Improve the Jones Act to Unlock Domestic Energy Flexibility
* Provide Relief from Unnecessary Tariffs on Critical Energy Inputs

STRENGTHEN RESILIENCE AND SUPPLY CHAINS
* Work with Persian Gulf Allies to Reduce Reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
* Strengthen Western Hemisphere Energy Security

## Technology Bridging Tradition and Innovation

How interface technology from Pepperl+Fuchs has been setting standards for almost 70 years and why
it is not losing any of its relevance in the age of digitalization.

[Go to Article][7]

## Main Topics
* [ [The E4SHUTTLE from Eurofork] ][8]
  
  #### Pallets Precisely Positioned
  
  In automated pallet shuttle warehouses, the position of machines must be tracked in real time.
  Eurofork relies on a powerful positioning system from Pepperl+Fuchs to make this possible.
  
  [Read more][9]
* [ [AI-generated biorefinery in futuristic style, with a dispenser dropping fuel made of
  agricultural residues] ][10]
  
  #### Second-Generation Ethanol—a Milestone in Brazil’s Energy Transition
  
  Brazil is focusing on second-generation ethanol to diversify its biofuel mix. As a technical
  partner, Pepperl+Fuchs supports the construction of new bioethanol plants.
  
  [Read more][11]
* [ [Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO of the Pepperl+Fuchs Group] ][12]
  
  #### Honoring Tradition. Enabling New Beginnings.
  
  Interview with Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO.
  
  [Read more][13]

[

##### View all articles

###### Filter articles according to your interests

][14]

### Alessandro Garola

Chief Technology Officer at Eurofork

The partnership with Pepperl+Fuchs enables us to be among the most competitive companies on the
market in economic and, above all, technological terms.

[Go to article][15]

### Claus Blödorn

Development Project Management at KNAPP AG

During the intense development phase, useful optimizations, even beyond the original specifications,
could be implemented quickly and easily. This close and trust-based relationship was ultimately the
key to success.here.

[Go to article][16]

### Philipp Jordan

company owner of eralytics

The solution from Pepperl+Fuchs allows the replacement to be carried out within a few minutes,
without long downtimes or time-consuming staff training.

[Go to article][17]

### Muthu Siva

Head of SEC Chennai, Pepperl+Fuchs

We don’t just sell products. We deliver purpose-built solutions that are engineered around our
customers’ exact needs.

[Go to article][18]

### Søren Gothil Hansen

Manager of Mechanical, Civil & Inspection (MCI) at Kalundborg Refinery

In order to meet the requirements of the next stage of digitalization, the hardware should be
brought up to the latest technical standards and have future-oriented 5G technology.

[Go to article][19]

### Nils Schwäbe

Product Line Manager at Swan Analytical Instruments

Exceeding the limit values can lead to a drastic drop in the performance of the electrolyzer after a
very short time. We are talking about a period of minutes or hours.

[Go to article][20]

### Lutz Liebers

Chief Operating Officer Process Automation at Pepperl+Fuchs

With Ethernet-APL, users can finally make full use of the wealth of information that modern field
devices and sensors record and make available. This changes everything for process plant operators!

[Go to Article][21]

### Andreas Redekop

Project Manager at Vision Machine Technic Bildverarbeitungssysteme GmbH
With its open architecture and modular approach, our software is simply unbeatable when it comes to
adaptability.

[Go to Article][22]

## Technology Bridging Tradition and Innovation

it is not losing any of its relevance in the age of digitalization.

[Go to Article][7]

## Main Topics
* [ [The E4SHUTTLE from Eurofork] ][8]
  
  #### Pallets Precisely Positioned
  
  In automated pallet shuttle warehouses, the position of machines must be tracked in real time.
  Eurofork relies on a powerful positioning system from Pepperl+Fuchs to make this possible.
  
  [Read more][9]
* [ [AI-generated biorefinery in futuristic style, with a dispenser dropping fuel made of
  agricultural residues] ][10]
  
  #### Second-Generation Ethanol—a Milestone in Brazil’s Energy Transition
  
  Brazil is focusing on second-generation ethanol to diversify its biofuel mix. As a technical
  partner, Pepperl+Fuchs supports the construction of new bioethanol plants.
  
  [Read more][11]
* [ [Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO of the Pepperl+Fuchs Group] ][12]
  
  #### Honoring Tradition. Enabling New Beginnings.
  
  Interview with Dr. Wilhelm Nehring, CEO, and Martin Walter, CFO.
  
  [Read more][13]

[

##### View all articles

###### Filter articles according to your interests

][14]

### Alessandro Garola

Chief Technology Officer at Eurofork

The partnership with Pepperl+Fuchs enables us to be among the most competitive companies on the
market in economic and, above all, technological terms.

[Go to article][15]

### Claus Blödorn

Development Project Management at KNAPP AG

During the intense development phase, useful optimizations, even beyond the original specifications,
could be implemented quickly and easily. This close and trust-based relationship was ultimately the
key to success.here.

[Go to article][16]

### Philipp Jordan

company owner of eralytics

The solution from Pepperl+Fuchs allows the replacement to be carried out within a few minutes,
without long downtimes or time-consuming staff training.

[Go to article][17]

### Muthu Siva

Head of SEC Chennai, Pepperl+Fuchs

We don’t just sell products. We deliver purpose-built solutions that are engineered around our
customers’ exact needs.

[Go to article][18]

### Søren Gothil Hansen

Manager of Mechanical, Civil & Inspection (MCI) at Kalundborg Refinery

In order to meet the requirements of the next stage of digitalization, the hardware should be
brought up to the latest technical standards and have future-oriented 5G technology.

[Go to article][19]

### Nils Schwäbe

Product Line Manager at Swan Analytical Instruments

Exceeding the limit values can lead to a drastic drop in the performance of the electrolyzer after a
very short time. We are talking about a period of minutes or hours.

[Go to article][20]

### Lutz Liebers

Chief Operating Officer Process Automation at Pepperl+Fuchs

With Ethernet-APL, users can finally make full use of the wealth of information that modern field
devices and sensors record and make available. This changes everything for process plant operators!

[Go to Article][21]

### Andreas Redekop

Project Manager at Vision Machine Technic Bildverarbeitungssysteme GmbH
With its open architecture and modular approach, our software is simply unbeatable when it comes to
adaptability.

[Go to Article][22]

The **Australia New Zealand Marine Biotechnology Society (ANZMBS)** is the leading voice for marine
biotechnology across Australasia. We connect scientists, industry, policy makers, and innovators to
advance the sustainable use of marine resources for the benefit of people, the planet, and the blue
economy.

Our mission is to foster collaboration, innovation, and education in marine biotechnology, from
fundamental research to real-world applications. We help to foster partnerships with academia,
industry, Indigenous communities, and international networks to promote responsible and impactful
marine biotechnology across the region.

specializing in formulation development, clinical and commercial cGMP manufacturing, and packaging
of complex oral solid dose, liquid, semi-solid, biologic, and sterile injectable pharmaceutical

with unparalleled quality to more than 100 markets around the world. Bora’s teams, technologies, and
facilities work seamlessly together with a shared commitment to supporting partners, minimizing
risk, and helping ensure therapies reach patients worldwide.

Working for a Safer Drug Supply Chain

The Bulk Pharmaceuticals Task Force (BPTF) is an industry trade organization representing
manufacturers of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), intermediates and excipients. BPTF
addresses regulatory and quality issues related to current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP)
compliance. 

 

 

[Prescription Drugs]

[[FDA-White-Oak-Building-01.jpg]][12]
[[Business Brainstorm]][13]

Quality Performance

BPTF is focused on quality throughout the supply chain. Creating a quality culture in manufacturing
requires dilligence and a need to keep informed and aware of ever-changing regulatory guidance
and industry standards.

 

Engaged

BPTF is a key stakeholder in negotiations with FDA on authorization of the Generic Drug User Fee
Amendments (GDUFA) and works with an array of industry trade groups to stay abreast of all
developments in the drug industry.

Advocacy

BPTF is a trusted industry voice respected within the drug supply chain and trusted by influential
leaders working on supply chain safety.

## Areas of focus
* [
  
  ### Oncology
  
  Building on our heritage in the treatment of solid tumors, we’re solving complex scientific
  problems for cancer patients everywhere.
  
  Learn more about Oncology ][70]
* [
  
  ### Hematology
  
  Known for delivering many transformational firsts in hematology, we’re committed to breaking new
  ground across diseases with high unmet need.
  
  Learn more about Hematology ][71]
* [
  
  ### Neuroscience
  
  We’re dedicated to championing the needs and experiences of people living with neurological and
  psychiatric diseases through disease-modifying and symptomatic therapies.
  
  Learn more about neuroscience ][72]
* [
  
  ### Immunology
  
  We’re working to deliver meaningful solutions that address unmet needs in dermatology,
  gastroenterology, pulmonology and rheumatology.
  
  Learn more about immunology ][73]
* [
  
  ### Cardiovascular
  
  Building on a 70-year legacy of paradigm-changing medicines, we’re leveraging our experience and
  expertise to take cardiovascular research to the next level.
  
  Learn more about cardiovascular ][74]

# Caltron Clays & Chemicals

Caltron Clays & Chemicals Pvt Ltd is No.1 Pharmaceutical and Cosmetic Raw Material manufacturers and
suppliers in India. Caltron Clays is an ISO 9001 Certified & CRISIL rated company, the only of its
kind in the minerals industry. Caltron Clays is a recognized export house specializing in the
processing and export of mineral, oxide, and chemicals.

[View Our Products][10]

## About Caltron

CALTRON is proudly celebrating its 26th year of successful operations having established a strong
reputation as a world-class manufacturer of natural calcium sources. Over the years, the company has
earned the trust of global customers through its unwavering commitment to quality innovation and
excellence.

Caltron proudly holds an extensive range of internationally recognized certifications including ISO
9001, ISO 22000, ISO 14001, ISO 18001, HACCP, HALAL, KOSHER, VEGAN, ECOCERT ORGANIC, SMETA 4 Pillar,
WHO-GMP compliance and DUNS registration. These certifications reflect the company’s dedication to
maintaining the highest standards across quality safety sustainability and ethical business
practices.

Guided by its tagline A Compliment to Supplement Caltron continues to deliver premium-quality
natural ingredients to customers worldwide. With its corporate office located in Mumbai India and a
state-of-the-art manufacturing site in India, the company serves a diverse range of industries with
natural mineral sources and natural cosmetic ingredients tailored to evolving market needs.

## We Have Built an Enviable Reputation

9

#### Products

We manufacture pharmaceutical raw materials, cosmetic raw materials, oil and gas drilling chemicals,
minerals, and animal feed supplements.

9

#### Markets

Our major market encompasses Caribbean, South/West Africa, North Europe, Middle East, South/West
Europe, Southeast Asia, and North America.

9

#### Vision

Caltron was visualized by Mr. S.N. JAIN the Managing Director of the company who molded the success
of the company.

## Our Products Range

[[Pharmaceutical Raw Materials | Caltron Clays]][11]

#### [Pharmaceutical Raw Materials][12]

Caltron Clays is a top Pharmaceutical Raw Materials manufacturing company and supplier in India.
Caltron is the leading manufacturer of Algae Calcium Powder or Algae Calcium Carbonate in India.
Caltron competes globally with the best available calcium sources in the world. Caltron Clays
supplies Pharmaceutical Raw Materials worldwide.

[[Cosmetic Raw Materials | Caltron Clays]][13]

#### [Cosmetic Raw Materials][14]

Caltron Clays is a top Cosmetic Raw Materials manufacturing company and supplier in India. Caltron
Clays & Chemicals is one of the renowned names in Cosmetic Industry for the Cosmetic Raw Materials
and their “Quality & Standards”. Caltron Clays supplies Cosmetic Raw Materials worldwide.

We provide innovative product solutions for sustainable progress. Our professional team works to
increase productivity and cost effectiveness on the market.

With roots dating back to 1885, Chr. Olesen has grown from a local Danish grocery store into an
international, family-owned business built on quality, reliability and long-term partnerships.

## FEED

The manufacturers constantly refine the ingredients. The producers constantly refine the products.
We pay respect to both by constantly refining the distribution.

Premium quality vitamins, minerals and proteins.
Developed by handpicked manufacturers.
And carefully distributed to the food industry.

### FOOD

### PHARMA

Distributing pharmaceutical ingredients requires specialized knowledge.  But it also requires
something as simple as being reliable.

Polymers, xantam gum and manganese carbonate. We distribute technical ingredients to the technical

  as each generation has done before.

[Φωτογραφία από Who we are]
Who we are

At Compass Marine Medical, we are proud to be a leading provider of specialized healthcare solutions
for the maritime industry. Established with the mission to enhance the health and safety of
seafarers worldwide, our company is built on a foundation of expertise, reliability, and innovation.

Our team comprises highly skilled medical professionals, qualified pharmacists, healthcare
practitioners, logistics specialists, and account managers, all dedicated to addressing the unique
medical needs of those at sea. With extensive experience in maritime medicine, we have earned a
reputation as a trusted partner for shipping companies, cruise lines, and offshore operations.
Compass Marine Medical proudly maintains membership with IMPA, ISSA and NVVS, reflecting our
commitment to upholding the highest standards within the maritime industry.

[See more][30]

## Fast and Reliable Medical Solutions in challenging environments

Our extensive experience and deep understanding of the industry allow us to operate effectively in
some of the world’s most challenging environments, providing round-the-clock medical supplies &
ensuring the health and safety of maritime crew members is never compromised.

 

 

[Φωτογραφία από Logistics]

### Logistics

At Compass, we take full responsibility for managing all logistics processes, ensuring that your
medical supplies are delivered reliably and on time. Our team meticulously coordinates each step,
providing you with peace of mind you’re your products are handled safely and efficiently throughout
the supply chain.

[Φωτογραφία από Global Network]

### Global Network

Compass Marine Medical boasts a widespread international reach, capable of delivering medical
supplies to a vast number of countries and ports worldwide. Supported by our extensive
pharmaceutical network, we ensure swift and reliable delivery, no matter the destination.

[Φωτογραφία από Regulatory expertise]

### Regulatory expertise

At Compass, we possess in-depth knowledge of the regulatory requirements associated with various
flag states. Our team ensures full compliance with the standards of each flag scale, meeting all
legal and safety obligations along with ensuring peace of mind for our clients.

[Φωτογραφία από Comprehensive Solutions]

### Comprehensive Solutions

At Compass, we deliver comprehensive maritime healthcare solutions, including vessel inventory
management system, new building projects, medical disposal, global distribution, telemedical
services, and mental health support, all focused on streamlining operations and ensuring the health,
safety, and wellbeing of your crew.

[Φωτογραφία από Accreditations]

### Accreditations

Compass Marine Medical complies with WHO, FDA, MHRA, DHA, DMA, MSN, and Maritime Health Authorities.
ISO 9001:2015 certification underscores our commitment to top-quality management across all services
and operations.

## Our Expertise

At Compass Marine Medical, we specialize in providing high-quality medical products that comply with
Good Distribution Practice (GDP) regulations. We tailor our supply solutions to meet the specific
demands of various sectors, including Commercial Shipping, Cruise, Yachting, and the Oil & Gas
Industry. Our expertise ensures that every product delivered upholds the highest standards of
safety, efficacy, and regulatory
compliance, supporting the unique needs of each business segment with precision and reliability.

U.S. Maritime Administration’s (MARAD) Gallant Ship Award during the U.S. Department of
Transportation’s National Maritime Day observance in Washington, D.C. The award, one of the maritime

courage and commitment to safety.

#### **Crowley’s First Avance Class Vessel Quetzal Begins Maiden Commercial Voyage**

Crowley’s new LNG-powered containership Quetzal has successfully begun its inaugural commercial
voyage, opening the company’s next era of faster, frequent ocean shipping with a new class of
vessels for the U.S., Central America and the Dominican Republic.

With capacity for up to 1,400 20-foot container equivalent units (TEUs), Quetzal and its three
forthcoming sister Avance Class ships will provide more cargo capacity while using lower-emissions
liquefied natural gas (LNG) for fuel. Quetzal and its sister ships were specifically designed to
accommodate a variety of container sizes, including 300 refrigerated container unit plugs.

## Frequently Asked Question

### 1. What does Farbe Firma specialize in manufacturing?

We are a specialized pharmaceutical formulation manufacturer focusing on Critical Care Injectables.
Our capabilities include liquid ampoules, sterile vials, Lyophilized (Freeze-Dried) injections, and
lipid emulsions across therapeutic areas like Anaesthesia, Pain Management, and Anti-infectives.


### 2. Are your manufacturing facilities WHO-GMP certified?

Yes, our manufacturing facility in Ankleshwar, Gujarat, is WHO-GMP certified. We adhere strictly to
global pharmacopeial standards (USP/BP/IP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to ensure the
highest sterility and quality for international markets.


### 3. Do you offer Contract Manufacturing (CMO) and CDMO services?

Yes, we provide comprehensive Contract Development and Manufacturing Organization (CDMO) services.
We support global pharmaceutical companies with formulation development, private label
manufacturing, and scale-up of sterile injectables under their own brand names.


### 4. Which countries do you currently export to?

Farbe Firma exports to over 30 countries across Latin America, Africa, CIS, Southeast Asia, and the
Middle East. We have a dedicated export department that manages logistics and supply chain
compliance for global partners.


### 5. Do you provide Regulatory Dossiers and registration support?

Absolutely. We support our partners with complete regulatory documentation, including Dossiers
(CTD/ACTD formats), Certificates of Analysis (COA), and Stability Data to facilitate smooth product
registration in your local market.


### 6. How can I request a price quote or product sample?

For bulk inquiries, contract manufacturing proposals, or sample requests, please contact our export
team directly at [director@farbefirma.org][57] or via WhatsApp at +91 932 797 4224.

At Glenmark, we are shaping the future of global health in a brave new world.

A new world that requires us to formulate bold new ways by relentlessly pursuing a dual mission:
pioneering transformative, innovative, breakthrough therapies that redefine treatment paradigms, and
expanding access to high-quality, essential medicines for underserved patients around the globe.

We unite scientific excellence, responsible execution and commercial agility to effectively address
unmet patient needs of today and proactively anticipate the emerging health needs of tomorrow.

link.

production.

## Local and craft makers you won't find on the big networks

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around the small producers the transnational

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

Why Inspire

## Specialty supply is a clinical decision — we treat it that way.

Specialty medicines aren't ordinary stock. A delayed oncology cycle, a missed dialysis session, an
ICU drug that didn't make it through customs — each one shows up in patient outcomes.

Inspire was built to remove those failures from the supply side. We focus narrowly on four specialty
areas, we keep the same molecules in stock month after month, and we are accountable for the chain
from manufacturer to hospital pharmacy.

[More about Inspire][20]
What we do for clinicians and procurement

## Registered. Sourced. Delivered — to clinical specification.

We are organised around what hospital pharmacy, oncology day-care units, dialysis centres and tender
boards actually need: a known supplier, a registered product, and dependable lead time.

### Scientific office support

Our in-house medical team works directly with prescribers — protocol fit, mechanism of action,
contraindications and SmPC documentation. Specialty supply backed by clinical understanding, not
just a sales call.

### Cold-chain reliability

Biologics, plasma-derived therapies and selected oncology agents are handled with
temperature-controlled logistics, transit monitoring and conditioned warehousing — verified at
hospital goods-in.

### Hospital & tender supply

Direct supply to private & public hospitals, oncology day-care units, dialysis providers, and county
/ national pharmaceutical tenders.

[Full capabilities][21]
Built around the prescriber

## The people who choose the medicine are the people we work for.

Oncologists, nephrologists, hospital pharmacists, intensivists, procurement officers — these are the
audiences our scientific office, regulatory team and supply chain are designed around.

If you are one of them and you need product information, supply confirmation or a tender response,
our team is one enquiry away.

[Contact our team][22]
For healthcare professionals

## Need product information, availability or supply support?

Our scientific office responds to medical-information requests, hospital-procurement enquiries and
tender queries within one working day.

## "Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value!"

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

### Khandelwal Associates is a Pharmaceutical Logistics Company, established in the year 1989.
### Providing services to more than 700 clients since 33 years. The firm majors in four services
### which are Carrying and Forwarding Agency Consignee Agency, Distributorship and Mother Warehouse
### Facility. Infrastructure with ultra-modern IT facilities and spacious warehouses. Provision of
### generator at the warehouse for uninterrupted power supply. Cold Room Facilities are also
### available for storage.
* 1989 : Our company was incorporated as Khandelwal Associatel, established in year 1989, as a
  Pharmaceutical Company in Indore. The foundation of our enterprise were laid with a passionate
  vision and the aim to achieve unparalleled success.
* 1995 : After years of conscientious practice in Pharmaceutical Business, we became associated with
  one of the top firms in the Pharmaceutical field, Emcure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.
* 2003 - 2004 : We established our main head office in indore with in house facilities for
  hospitality, support, operations, cold chain facilities, material handeling and three warehouses.
  Also got associated with Zuventus Healthcare Ltd.
* 2005 : Association with Medopharm Pharmaceuticals.
* 2008 - 2011 : Collaborated with Adley Labs, Gennova Biopharmaceuticals, Cachet Pharmaceuticals
  Private Limited and Talent Healthcare.
* 2013 - 2014 : We became C&F agents for Koey Pharmaceuticals and also became Adley Mother Warehouse
  Facility.

## Services

"To give real service you must add something which cannot be bought or measured with money, and that
is sincerity and integrity."

#### Carrying & Forwarding Agent

As a carrying and forwarding agent receiving the goods from the factories, warehousing these goods,
receiving dispatch orders from the principal, and much more.

#### Consignee Agent

As a consignee agent, the company's name is reflected in the consignee column in the bill of lading
or in other words the “buyer” of the cargo.

#### Mother Warehouse Facility

A mother warehouse is a commercial building for storage of goods. Mother Warehouses are used by
exporters, wholesalers, transport businesses, etc.

#### Distributorship

It’s about getting the right medicines to the right patients at the right time, safely and
efficiently. Primary distributors sustain a complex supply chain.

# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## About Us

## WHO WE ARE

In 2005, we started as a small-scale distribution business. After years of success in the trading
and distribution sectors, and after building a strong network for marketing across India, we
transition into the manufacturing industry in the year 2015.
Marine Lifesciences has been our initial venture. a facility solely dedicated to the production of
external preparations like creams and ointments and soft gelatin capsules.
We have a team of professionals whose mission is to develop products that meet the market
requirement and a dedicated quality team to ensure the right product is delivered in the market.
Therefore our commitment to quality and our service to customers has achieved us a well-known brand
in the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical industry.

## SOFT GEL

We are capable of producing 600 million capsules in a single shift every year.
[ Read More ][27]

## EXTERNAL PREPARATION

We can produce more than 48 million tubes per annum  
[ Read More ][28]

## Why Choose Us

Our facility meets all WHO-GMP guidelines and follows cGMP guidelines to ensure quality. Our
PLC-based machines follow the latest safety standards.
Before taking material into commercial production, it goes through specified quality checks as per
our SOP for Raw Material Testing.
 
Each formulation has a specific SOP where process validation and quality checks are carried out in
process.
 
 
A team of skilled professionals conducts constant R & D to provide insight and help improve current
processes, which increases production and quality.
Our quick response team provides regular follow-ups to our clients as well as quick responses to
customer inquiries.

## Our Operations

Marine Lifesciences is a soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit. Having established
in the year 2015, today Marine Lifesciences is considered one of the quality manufacturers of soft
gel supplements and pain relieving ointments.
Marine Lifesciences is a WHO-GMP certified soft-gelatin and external ointment manufacturing unit
located in Himachal Pradesh, India. Established in 2015, we are considered one of the quality
manufacturers of soft gel supplements and pain relieving ointments. Our facility is highly regulated
and follows all cGMP guidelines. Our manufacturing unit has a yearly capacity of delivering around
240 million capsules and 30 million ointments a year. We also do contract manufacturing for big
Indian MNCs like Lupin, Aristo, Zydus, Healthkart, Trubasics, Apollo, and many more. As part of the
Marine group, we are an emerging player in the Pharmaceutical Industry with operations in Dubai,
Sudan, Myanmar, and Afghanistan, and we are continuously growing.

## The Global Marine Pharmaceuticals Pipeline

from academia, industry, and government who are currently involved in the global marine
pharmaceuticals pipeline, which involves both preclinical and clinical research on the pharmacology
of marine-derived chemicals.


The content of the website is aimed at researchers in academia, industry, and government with an
interest in the preclinical and clinical pharmacology of marine compounds, as well as those
individuals among the general public who have an interest in the pharmaceutical potential of the
enormous biodiversity of organisms present in the world's oceans. The global marine pharmaceuticals
pipeline website will also hopefully contribute to inspire and attract a new generation of students
interested in pursuing studies in the clinical and preclinical pharmacology of marine natural

## Together, we are Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics.

With combined experience across healthcare, aviation, and complex secure logistics, we drive the
success of our clients through innovation and precision.

At UPS Healthcare, we have taken our best and made it better. As a leading healthcare logistics
company, we’ve invested in the latest technology and expanded our global footprint, allowing us to
be more responsive and agile than ever, ensuring every patient gets the critical support they need,
when they need it, where they need it.

MNX has officially joined Marken under one global brand: Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics.
Formerly MNX, the brand brings decades of expertise in radiopharmaceuticals, aviation, and complex
secure logistics. While the MNX name is retiring, commitment to serving clients and supporting
patients remains stronger than ever.

Polar Speed is part of Marken, UPS Healthcare Precision Logistics: Polar Speed brings forth our
in-network pharmacies and strengthens our patient driven services portfolio.

# Welcome to Marks Marine Pharmacy

Welcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine PharmacyWelcome to Marks Marine Pharmacy

## About Us

#### A brick and mortar community pharmacy

Marks Marine Pharmacy is a brick-and-mortar store inside a medical clinic, also serving the local
community in Vancouver, British Columbia. Experience peace of mind knowing your medication ships
directly from our fully regulated Canadian Pharmacy, dispensed by a licensed Canadian pharmacist.

#### Meet our pharmacy manager

Robert Rosenblatt - licensed Canadian Pharmacist, graduated from the University of British Columbia.
Rob experienced a massive influx of walk-in American customers driving from Washington and Oregon,
specifically to pick up prescription medication from Marks Pharmacy on Cambie. Therefore, Rob set up
a division of Marks as close as possible to the Vancouver international airport (10 minutes away)
for the sole purpose of benefiting shipping logistics and turnaround time.



Marks has been a well-known Pharmacy chain on the west coast of Canada since the 1950s by Pharmacist
Gordan Marks (RPH 1948 UBC, R.I.P) and then Pharmacist Marvin Nider (RPH UBC 1973, R.I.P). Then Rob
set up a Canada Post station inside the Pharmacy and scheduled the last possible postal pickup.



With 30 years of experience, Rob understands the industry very well.

Now 73, still fully licensed, Rob is happy, in phenomenal shape from a lifetime of proper health and
fitness, practicing what he preaches for complete health and Wellness. Rob retired at 70, passing it
off to second-generation Jordan after working closely together for 20 years, effectively passing the
torch to the next generation.

#### We also ship anywhere within Canada

Experience the ease of use by shipping your medication right to your door.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

### Transportlogistik

Ob regional, national, Komplett- bzw. Teil­ladungen, gekühlt oder ungekühlt. Im Handel gehören wir zu
den Top 3 der Filial­versorgung, haben uns im Werks­verkehr für Automotive und Chemie etabliert und
fahren Ihre Güter zuverlässig an ihren Bestimmungsort.

125 Jahre Erfahrung spiegeln sich in zahl­reichen Erweiterungen der Kompetenzen, abseits der
Logistik: Bereits seit den 70ern bauen wir Logistik­zentren und kümmern uns um deren Instand­haltung,
mit fach­männischem Personal, zur richtigen Zeit, am gewünschten Ort.

Industry*”** scheduled during **November** 1**3-14, 2023** at **Barcelona, Spain.**

The event offers a best platform with its well organized scientific program to the audience which
includes interactive panel discussions, keynote lectures, plenary talks and poster Sessions.
Pharmaceutics & Drug Delivery Systems is a global platform to discuss and learn about research
Advances in Drug Delivery Research, [Drug Targeting and Design][78], Nano medicine &
Nanotechnology, [Pharmaceutical Technology][79], Medicinal Chemistry and Drug Discovery, Novel Drug
Delivery Systems, Pre-formulation & formulation  aspects, Bio pharmaceutics and Biologic Drugs.

**WHO SHOULD ATTEND?**

The conference invites Directors, Group Leaders, Professors, Associate Professors, Lecturers,
Research Associates, Scientists, Investigators,  business delegates from Leading Universities,
Pharmaceutical companies, Formulation Scientists, Medical Devices, Researchers, Health care
professionals, across the globe providing a better podium, interconnecting the latest research,
technological developments in the arena as well as therapeutic aspects. Participating at [Novel Drug
Delivery][80] International conference will be an excellent opportunity to meet eminent
personalities in the fields of pharmaceutics and learn about the latest technological advancements
in Novel Drug Delivery systems.

The scientific program includes Keynote & Plenary talks, Video Presentations, [Poster
Presentations][81] and E-Posters. Furthermore, oral communications of (post)doctoral junior
scientists will be considered. It is the goal of the organizers to make this meeting an event of
scientific excellence, attractive to both industrial and academic scientists in Pharmaceutical &
Novel Drug Delivery systems of Relevant Field.

•   Networking for future collaboration
•   Add Research Value

converting a new chemical entity to a completely novel product which can be used for the treatment
of any disease. Pharmaceutics is one of the major components that are taken into consideration while
developing a novel drug as it primarily involves in predicting the perfect amount of dosage that is
necessary for an individual to get treated for the specific condition.

## Our history

# 1949

# 1949

The Gjendemsjø family has been innovative for generations. It all started in 1949 when Lauritz
decided to be a fisherman instead of taking over his family farm. Since then, he was a fisherman by
heart. He later became a pioneer by building the first fishing boat designed with thrusters. In the
late 60's, Lauritz wanted to take things to a new level and increase the value of the fish they
caught. This was the beginning of a wonderful adventure that he shared with his son Leif Kjetil.

# 1974

# 1974

As a young child Leif Kjetil wanted to help his father and at the age of 8 he started his career
cutting cod tongues in his father`s fish processing-factory and selling them as delicacy to
relatives and neighbors. He learned early that we should only harvest what we need and utilize
everything we harvest from nature. This has become a mantra that he have brought with him ever
since.

# 1982

# 1982

Growing up, Leif Kjetil used to help out at the factory after school, and as his father he also fell
in love with the profession. As he grew older he was driving along the Norwegian coast selling fish
products to local shops, while he also took on more responsibility and started developing new
products and packaging.

# 1985

# 1985

To optimize the utilization of the trimmings from the processing plant, Lauritz and Leif Kjetil got
the idea to use residual material from the fish to produce fish protein and fish oil and in 1986
Ocean Napro (later called Napro Pharma) was established. They produced marine products in two piece
hard gelatin capsules and packed it in bottles. They were actually among the first in the world to
put fish oil and fish protein in two piece hard gelatin capsules.

# 1989

# 1989

Leif Kjetil and his partners established Ocean Lipro and built their first omega-3 factory in
Brattvåg. When Brødrene Aarsether’s Cod Liver oil factory came for sale in 1989 they saw a great
opportunity and decided to buy the factory in Ålesund, which was the largest cod liver oil factory
in Norway. Leif Kjetil and his team changed the factory from being a cod liver oil factory to become
one of the first factories in the world to produce omega-3 concentrates.

# 1997

# 1997

Leif Kjetil sold his shares in Ocean Lipro to devote more of his time on Napro Pharma. Together with
partners he started another company (Norwegian Oils) that was located next to Napro Pharma, which
was focused on omega-3 concentrates and natural marine oils. These two companies later merged into
Napro Pharma.

# 2006

# 2006

As the years passed, Leif Kjetil had been greatly influenced by his father’s way of thinking. And
when Napro Pharma was sold to Cognis, they had created one of the most successful and innovative
Omega-3 fish oil companies in the world.

# 2007

# 2007

Leif Kjetil began planning the next step for the Gjendemsjø family. He wanted to create a paradigm
shift in the Omega-3 industry - with focus on eco-friendly and flexible production, R&D, sustainable
raw materials and new healthy marine lipids. With a game changing concept ready – Pharma Marine™ was
established, with the aim to develop new and healthy natural lipids from sustainable marine sources,
with a focus on utilizing the trimmings from food production of seafood.

# 2007

# 2007

professionals in the field of lipid production. Two of the team members, Ingjerd Lystad (Chief

# 2008

# 2008

It was very important for Pharma Marine™ that the new product would be from sustainable raw
materials and we wanted to bring something new to the omega-3 market. The idea about omega-3 oil
from squid was born in 2007, and in 2009 the first batch with CalaMarine® was produced. This product
became the first omega-3 concentrates in the world made from trimmings of food production of squid.

# 2011

# 2011

In 2011 Pharma Marine™ saw the need of being able to offer customers the more classic type of fish
oil from anchovies, sardines and mackerel and launched the ingredient line LipidMarine™. This is a
line with a wide range of high quality EPA and DHA oils with a great sensory profile.

# 2014

# 2014

Leif Kjetil had for a long time had a dream about using the trimmings, not only the liver, from
Norwegian fishing boats to produce omega-3 oils. Being from a fisher family he knew very well that
the fishermen were looking for ways to utilize the trimmings of food production of wild-caught fish.
When the knowledgeable and innovative Norwegian fisheries invested in production of fish oil and
fish meal onboard the fishing vessels – they became the perfect supplier and partner for Pharma
Marine. As a result of this, CodMarine® was launched in 2014. Because of this collaboration with the
local fisheries the CodMarine® – products has a tracing system, making it possible for the consumer
to trace their oil back to the fishing vessel and the area the fish was caught.

# 2016

# 2016

After a lot of thinking and experimenting about how we could help consumers increase their omega-3

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

oncology innovators, this transition creates a high-stakes environment where the ability to rapidly

70,000 partnering meetings, and transformative regulatory updates from the FDA and EMA.

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

[[EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][22]

### [EHA 2026 | BRUIN CLL-322: Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][23]

Abstract: EHA-7224 Short: LB5001 BRUIN CLL-322 (NCT04965493) is the first randomized Phase 3 trial
to evaluate a non-covalent BTK inhibitor–based triplet regimen in previously treated CLL/SLL. With a
data cutoff of February 2, 2026, and results presented at EHA 2026, the trial demonstrated that
fixed-duration pirtobrutinib + venetoclax–rituximab (PVR) significantly improved progression-free
survival over venetoclax–rituximab (VenR) alone, meeting its primary endpoint across all key
subgroups. Overall survival data were not yet mature but trended in favor of PVR. This represents
Lilly's fourth Phase 3 CLL win for pirtobrutinib (Jaypirca®) and positions PVR as a potential new
standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

# Boat Supplies & Boating Accessories in Australia

Are you a boat owner who has been wondering “where can I find a [marine shop near me][28] that can
supply everything I need?” The Marine Centre is the boating warehouse boat owners throughout the
country turn to for all the marine supplies they need, and we can help you too.

As one of the leading boating stores in the country, we stock a huge range of the very best boat
supplies and boating accessories Australia wide. We can supply customers all over the country with
all kinds of electronic, anchoring, seating, plumbing, cleaning, maintenance, safety and other
boating and fishing related products, available for purchase online or from our warehouse in
Derrimut, Melbourne.

## Quality Marine Supplies You Can Depend On

The Marine Centre stocks a vast range of quality boating supplies, including [marine supplies for
anchoring][29], docking, plumbing and much more. No matter what supplies you need for your boat, you
can rest assured that our products are constructed from quality materials and made to last.

Our complete range of marine supplies includes:
* Anchoring and docking
* Cabin, deck and hull
* Electronics
* Plumbing and pumps
* Seating products
* Refrigeration and food storage
* Cleaning and maintenance
* Safety items
* Sporting equipment
* Trailer parts and accessories

## The Best Range of Stainless Steel Boat Accessories in Australia

If you’re looking for the best range of stainless steel [boat accessories in Australia][30], look no
further. The Marine Centre offers an impressive selection of stainless steel boat accessories
online, with everything from anchors and cup holders through to rod holders, steering wheels and
outriggers. Our stainless steel accessories offer unparalleled durability and corrosion resistance,
making them an ideal choice for withstanding saltwater and other harsh marine conditions.

## Why Shop with Us?

The Marine Centre has earned a reputation as one of the best boat shops in the business thanks to
our team of boating experts. Every staff member at our boat shop has extensive knowledge when it
comes to [boat supplies][31] and boat accessories in Australia for all kinds of vessels. Whether you
own a sailboat, yacht, powerboat or any other type of vessel, we can help you get what you need to
make your time on the water more enjoyable.

The Marine Centre is also the boating warehouse to turn to if your vessel requires any repair,
servicing or maintenance work. Our first-class boat aftercare centre is staffed by a team of boating
technicians who can carry out professional repair, service or maintenance work for all kinds of new
and used fibreglass vessels, with an extended warranty offered on all our work. [BOOK FREE
CONSULTATION][32] today!

## Why Choose Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting

With Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting, gain access to reliable research reports and expert
analysis across all healthcare segments.

[ Learn about Towards Healthcare Research & Consulting ][11]

### Customer Insights

We provide high-quality Syndicated and Custom Research insights using statistic-representation of
data by synthesizing a range of secondary and primary sources.

### Market Databook

Availability of Market Databook with proven historical numbers along with the driven market
estimation data through strategic implementation, and availability of feasible tools to determine
the market opportunity and potential impact.

periodicals, Mergers and Acquisitions along with the SWOT analysis.

Complete analysis of all the segments covered in the report, with their market dynamics to get an
overall understanding of the current market scenario.

complete sense of specific market that will impact your revenue.

## Our
## mission

#### UNDP works in 170 countries and territories to eradicate poverty while protecting the planet.
#### We help countries develop strong policies, skills, partnerships and institutions so they can
#### sustain their progress.

## What we do

UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development. We support countries and
communities as they work to eradicate poverty, implement the Paris Agreement on climate change and
achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. We advocate for transformative change, and we connect
countries to the resources they need to help people build a better life.

[Learn more][25]

[Construction worker in a neon safety vest and knit cap grips a lifting hook under blue
scaffolding.]

### Human development on a healthy planet

UNDP works with countries to expand people’s choices for a future where prosperity and
sustainability advance together, leaving no one behind. Through integrated, evidence-driven action
aligned with national priorities, UNDP works to accelerate human development while easing pressures
on the planet.

[Photograph of four smiling children posing among rocky ruins under a bright blue sky.]

### Prosperity for all

UNDP focusses on creating prosperity for all, while maintaining our strong footprint in poverty and
inequality programming. This shift aligns with our partners' changing aspirations: moving beyond the
goalpost of a minimum poverty line to build dynamic, resilient economies and societies where
everyone can thrive.

[Person in a light blue shirt holds a card with a circular logo outdoors; crowd and trees in back.]

### Effective governance

UNDP develops accountable, people-centred and rights-based governance. Using systems thinking,
innovation and strategic foresight, UNDP helps countries develop more agile, anticipatory governance
and policymaking and provide responsive services and economic opportunities, including increased
access to services through digitalization and AI.

[Two construction workers on a dirt site with chalk markings; one points, rock piles behind.]

#### UNDP works in 170 countries and territories to eradicate poverty while protecting the planet.
#### We help countries develop strong policies, skills, partnerships and institutions so they can
#### sustain their progress.

## What we do

UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development. We support countries and
communities as they work to eradicate poverty, implement the Paris Agreement on climate change and
achieve the Sustainable Development Goals. We advocate for transformative change, and we connect
countries to the resources they need to help people build a better life.

[Learn more][25]

[Construction worker in a neon safety vest and knit cap grips a lifting hook under blue
scaffolding.]

### Human development on a healthy planet

UNDP works with countries to expand people’s choices for a future where prosperity and
sustainability advance together, leaving no one behind. Through integrated, evidence-driven action
aligned with national priorities, UNDP works to accelerate human development while easing pressures
on the planet.

[Photograph of four smiling children posing among rocky ruins under a bright blue sky.]

### Prosperity for all

UNDP focusses on creating prosperity for all, while maintaining our strong footprint in poverty and
inequality programming. This shift aligns with our partners' changing aspirations: moving beyond the
goalpost of a minimum poverty line to build dynamic, resilient economies and societies where
everyone can thrive.

[Person in a light blue shirt holds a card with a circular logo outdoors; crowd and trees in back.]

### Effective governance

UNDP develops accountable, people-centred and rights-based governance. Using systems thinking,
innovation and strategic foresight, UNDP helps countries develop more agile, anticipatory governance
and policymaking and provide responsive services and economic opportunities, including increased
access to services through digitalization and AI.

[Two construction workers on a dirt site with chalk markings; one points, rock piles behind.]

### Crisis resilience

From day one of a crisis, UNDP focuses on protecting development gains and reducing risk, laying the
groundwork for recovery and eventual exit from reliance on humanitarian assistance. UNDP acts as a
“bridge-builder” between the humanitarian, development and peacebuilding systems, helping to
maintain continuity across response phases and advance long-term development.

[Person in a cornfield holds a round woven basket of yellow corn.]

### Healthy planet

UNDP is a leading connector at the nexus of planet and development, delivering integrated solutions
on climate change, disasters, biodiversity loss, energy, chemicals and waste, while advancing
development priorities. Translating global commitments into effective local action, we support
countries to assess their options for achieving just and sustainable transitions.

[Photograph of hands holding a smartphone displaying a colorful app interface.]

### Digital and AI transformation

UNDP’s broad expertise and country-driven approach allow us to support holistic digital
transformation in an integrated, systemic way. UNDP has worked with over 120 countries to leverage
digitalization, including helping institutions and people develop the capabilities to access and use
technology and data; and supporting countries to implement robust digital public infrastructure.

[Three costumed performers on a wooden porch, center in a white headdress, brown-gold outfits.]

### Gender equality

Complementing the work of UN Women, UNDP designs its interventions for a deliberate impact on gender
equality, seen by partners as one of its most effective areas of work. Through its trusted
relationships with governments, UNDP is well placed to help advance women’s empowerment across all
dimensions of development.

[Market fruit stand with a shirtless vendor serving fruit to a customer, surrounded by melons.]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
